about: Released weights of the Greek letter reader (kit/letterread.py). Weights are not in git; kit.letterread.resolve_weights downloads a named model once into ~/.cache/scrolls-kit/letters (or $KIT_LETTER_WEIGHTS) and refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs. Every string the reader returns is model output, not a reading.
